response.original_title: Bertrand Chamayou performs Franz Liszt With Jakob Lehmann & Les Siècles
response.overview: For Franz Liszt, the piano was a unique tool of expression with which he shaped 19th century music like no other composer. His two piano concertos, composed almost simultaneously over the course of many years, broke free from the formal constraints of the genre to create a continuous narrative reminiscent a symphonic poem. Bertrand Chamayou is soloist in an historically informed performance with the Les Siècles orchestra.
response.title: Bertrand Chamayou performs Franz Liszt With Jakob Lehmann & Les Siècles
